CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS idempotency_requests(
 user_id BIGINT NOT NULL REFERENCES users(id),
 scope TEXT NOT NULL,
 idempotency_key TEXT NOT NULL,
 request_hash TEXT NOT NULL,
 response_json TEXT NOT NULL,
 created_at TEXT NOT NULL,
 PRIMARY KEY(user_id,scope,idempotency_key)
)

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS auth_attempts(
 id BIGINT GENERATED BY DEFAULT AS IDENTITY PRIMARY KEY,
 account_hash TEXT NOT NULL,
 origin_hash TEXT NOT NULL,
 attempted_at BIGINT NOT NULL
)
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS auth_attempts_account_time ON auth_attempts(account_hash,attempted_at)
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS auth_attempts_origin_time ON auth_attempts(origin_hash,attempted_at)
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS auth_attempts_time ON auth_attempts(attempted_at)

INSERT INTO schema_migrations(version,checksum,applied_at) SELECT '001_security_integrity','c3d1fa36db29b2b5bca9daa9a1ee329b94909e1f1d3a53bc248a05bfa5040b20',to_char(clock_timestamp() AT TIME ZONE 'UTC','YYYY-MM-DD"T"HH24:MI:SS.US')||'+00:00' WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM schema_migrations WHERE version='001_security_integrity')

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS attendance_terminals(
 id BIGINT GENERATED BY DEFAULT AS IDENTITY PRIMARY KEY,
 name TEXT NOT NULL,
 work_id BIGINT NOT NULL REFERENCES works(id),
 active BIGINT NOT NULL DEFAULT 1 CHECK(active IN (0,1)),
 created_by BIGINT NOT NULL REFERENCES users(id),
 created_at TEXT NOT NULL,
 revoked_at TEXT
)

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS attendance_authorizations(
 token_hash TEXT NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY,
 employee_id BIGINT NOT NULL REFERENCES employees(id),
 terminal_id BIGINT NOT NULL REFERENCES attendance_terminals(id),
 created_by BIGINT NOT NULL REFERENCES users(id),
 created_at TEXT NOT NULL,
 expires_at TEXT NOT NULL,
 used_at TEXT
)

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS attendance_records(
 id BIGINT GENERATED BY DEFAULT AS IDENTITY PRIMARY KEY,
 record_uid TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE,
 employee_id BIGINT NOT NULL REFERENCES employees(id),
 work_id BIGINT NOT NULL REFERENCES works(id),
 terminal_id BIGINT NOT NULL REFERENCES attendance_terminals(id),
 mark_type TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(mark_type IN ('ENTRADA','INICIO_INTERVALO','RETORNO_INTERVALO','SAIDA')),
 marked_at TEXT NOT NULL,
 verification_method TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(verification_method='DEMO_SUPERVISIONADO'),
 verification_result TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(verification_result='SIMULADO'),
 is_test BIGINT NOT NULL CHECK(is_test=1),
 created_by BIGINT NOT NULL REFERENCES users(id),
 authorization_hash TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE REFERENCES attendance_authorizations(token_hash)
)
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS attendance_records_employee_time ON attendance_records(employee_id,marked_at,id)
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS attendance_records_work_time ON attendance_records(work_id,marked_at,id)
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS attendance_authorizations_expiry ON attendance_authorizations(expires_at)

INSERT INTO schema_migrations(version,checksum,applied_at) SELECT '002_attendance_experimental','0b94934fbf95230c2acad9bf185ee428b4ec548a6b45f4b0e5fcf7cdb88d9503',to_char(clock_timestamp() AT TIME ZONE 'UTC','YYYY-MM-DD"T"HH24:MI:SS.US')||'+00:00' WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM schema_migrations WHERE version='002_attendance_experimental')

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS attendance_activation_codes(
 token_hash TEXT NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY,
 terminal_id BIGINT NOT NULL REFERENCES attendance_terminals(id),
 created_by BIGINT NOT NULL REFERENCES users(id),
 created_at TEXT NOT NULL,
 expires_at TEXT NOT NULL,
 used_at TEXT
)

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS attendance_device_sessions(
 token_hash TEXT NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY,
 terminal_id BIGINT NOT NULL REFERENCES attendance_terminals(id),
 created_by BIGINT NOT NULL REFERENCES users(id),
 created_at TEXT NOT NULL,
 expires_at TEXT NOT NULL,
 revoked_at TEXT
)

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS attendance_device_authorizations(
 token_hash TEXT NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY REFERENCES attendance_authorizations(token_hash),
 device_session_hash TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES attendance_device_sessions(token_hash)
)
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS attendance_activation_terminal_expiry ON attendance_activation_codes(terminal_id,expires_at)
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS attendance_device_terminal_expiry ON attendance_device_sessions(terminal_id,expires_at)
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS attendance_device_authorization_session ON attendance_device_authorizations(device_session_hash)

INSERT INTO schema_migrations(version,checksum,applied_at) SELECT '003_attendance_devices','ec8e58f87c95cedd33e3414b4a2bde2c7a3dc1b85b21851078706d1555cb4960',to_char(clock_timestamp() AT TIME ZONE 'UTC','YYYY-MM-DD"T"HH24:MI:SS.US')||'+00:00' WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM schema_migrations WHERE version='003_attendance_devices')

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS attendance_face_references(
 employee_id BIGINT PRIMARY KEY REFERENCES employees(id),
 version_uid TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE,
 encrypted_image TEXT NOT NULL,
 authorized_by BIGINT NOT NULL REFERENCES users(id),
 authorization_basis TEXT NOT NULL,
 created_at TEXT NOT NULL,
 expires_at TEXT NOT NULL
)

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS attendance_face_grants(
 token_hash TEXT NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY REFERENCES attendance_authorizations(token_hash),
 device_session_hash TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES attendance_device_sessions(token_hash),
 reference_version TEXT NOT NULL,
 algorithm TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(algorithm='OPENCV_SFACE_YUNET_V1')
)

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS attendance_facial_records(
 id BIGINT GENERATED BY DEFAULT AS IDENTITY PRIMARY KEY,
 record_uid TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE,
 employee_id BIGINT NOT NULL REFERENCES employees(id),
 work_id BIGINT NOT NULL REFERENCES works(id),
 terminal_id BIGINT NOT NULL REFERENCES attendance_terminals(id),
 mark_type TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(mark_type IN ('ENTRADA','INICIO_INTERVALO','RETORNO_INTERVALO','SAIDA')),
 marked_at TEXT NOT NULL,
 verification_method TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(verification_method='FACIAL_EXPERIMENTAL'),
 verification_result TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(verification_result='CORRESPONDENCIA_CONFIRMADA'),
 is_test BIGINT NOT NULL CHECK(is_test=1),
 created_by BIGINT NOT NULL REFERENCES users(id),
 authorization_hash TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE REFERENCES attendance_face_grants(token_hash)
)
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS attendance_facial_records_employee_time ON attendance_facial_records(employee_id,marked_at,id)
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS attendance_facial_records_work_time ON attendance_facial_records(work_id,marked_at,id)
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS attendance_face_grants_session ON attendance_face_grants(device_session_hash)
